Record Class ApiKeyCredential

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.who.apikey.ApiKeyCredential
Record Components:
id - the stable UUID for this credential record
name - a human-readable label identifying this key (e.g. "Production server")
keyHash - the SHA-256 hex digest of the raw API key
scopes - the permissions the key may use, at most
createdAt - when the key was made
expiresAt - when the key stops signing in
lastUsedAt - when the key last signed in, to within the last-used interval; null when it never has
All Implemented Interfaces:
Credential
public record ApiKeyCredential(UUID id, String name, String keyHash, Set<String> scopes, Instant createdAt, Instant expiresAt, Instant lastUsedAt) extends Record implements Credential
Credential representing an API key, stored as a SHA-256 hash.

The raw key is never stored — only the hash reaches the database. The id() UUID is stable for the lifetime of the credential and used as the FK to the identity mapping table. The name() is a human-readable label (e.g. "Production server", "CI pipeline") to help users identify and manage their keys; it is also the label security events report.

A key signs in with at most its scopes(), and only those its identity still holds, and only before expiresAt().
